subject: Exec workshop — accommodation allocation, VIP adjacency & preflight manifest
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Pacifica Reservations <reservations@pacifica-hotel.com>, Event OnSite - Ops <ops@eventonsite.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Exec workshop — block request & adjacency needs (Jul 19-21)

Hi Kelsey / Ops team,

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. To formalize, Redwood is planning an executive workshop at Pacifica July 19–21 (arrival evening of 7/18 for a small number of VIPs). We need a block inventory and a handful of adjacency guarantees so we can finalize the attendee itinerary. High-level asks: 

- Block: 48 total guest rooms across the nights of 7/18–7/21 (45 room-nights per night average). Please propose a 10% buffer for late adds.
- Room mix: 36 standard king/double-convert rooms, 8 junior suites, 4 executive suites.
- VIP adjacency: 2 executive suites adjacent (same corridor, no connecting door) preferred for two C-suite attendees. Can you hold a cluster if possible?
- Accessibility: 2 ADA-compliant rooms with roll-in showers.
- Early check-in/late checkout: two VIPs may request guaranteed 10:00AM early check-in and 2:00PM late-checkout.
- Mini-fridge requests: 6 rooms need mini-fridge / grocery hold (lactose-free snacks).
- Master bill vs split: We will prefer a master bill for rooms and F&B (Concur reconciliation), but need a split for incidentals. Please confirm payment/deposit terms and the cut-off date for releasing the block.

Attached: initial_block_request.pdf with estimated arrival times. I will upload the attendee sleep-preferences sheet by EOD.

Timeline: can you send a preliminary inventory and sample master bill by EOD Wed (6/30)? If we get adjacency confirmed, we will lock the suite holds by Thu 7/1 and provide the final roster by Mon 7/5.

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Program Lead, Events & Exec Ops
Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai
(555) 555-0164

From: Pacifica Reservations <reservations@pacifica-hotel.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Event OnSite - Ops <ops@eventonsite.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — block request & adjacency needs (Jul 19-21)

Hi Ava — appreciate the details. Quick summary of what we can hold and associated terms (see attached proposed-master-bill-0629.pdf):

- Block hold: 50 rooms held (36 king/convert, 8 junior suites, 6 executive suites) with a 7-day release on unused inventory. We increased executive suites to 6 briefly to give you adjacency flexibility; will release extras if not locked by 7/1.
- Adjacent suite options: we have two executive suites on 7th floor that are adjacent (rooms 701/703). We can hold them pending your confirmation.
- ADA: 2 ADA rooms confirmed (1st floor).
- Early check-in / late checkout: Guaranteed for the two VIPs with a 75 USD early check-in fee and 75 USD late checkout fee unless covered on master bill.
- Mini-fridge/grocery hold: We can pre-stock 6 rooms with requested items; note dietary items must be specified in the attached form.
- Master bill terms: 50% deposit 30 days prior to arrival required to confirm the master bill; remaining balance due at checkout. Incidentals can be split to individual cards; please provide a reconciliation contact.

Requested next steps:
1) Confirm which two exec suites you want held (701/703 recommended).
2) Share your attendee sleep-preferences spreadsheet and indication of which rooms should be ADA / fridge / early-check.
3) Confirm whether master bill will be card-on-file or direct invoice for Redwood.

Attachments: proposed-master-bill-0629.pdf

Regards,
Kelsey Harris
Senior Sales Manager, Pacifica Hotel & Conference Center
reservations@pacifica-hotel.com
(406) 555-0122

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Pacifica Reservations <reservations@pacifica-hotel.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 14:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — block request & adjacency needs (Jul 19-21)

Ava / Kelsey —

Thanks for the proposal. A couple of internal priorities to flag so you can pencil them into the block: 

- VIP roster & tiebreak:
  • CEO (A. Patel) — executive suite required; low-noise preference.
  • Head of Product (S. Gallagher) — junior suite acceptable but prefers quiet floor.
  • Visiting board member (external) — ADA if available (prefer 1st-floor proximity).

- Adjacency: please hold 701/703 for CEO + CPO until EOD Thu 7/1 — if we can't confirm, release 703 and keep a junior suite pending.
- Budget / billing: We will take master bill for rooms + meeting F&B, but require incidentals to be charged to personal cards. Marcus, can your team be the reconciliation contact? Marcus: pls confirm.
- Shuttle & arrivals: Ops to share expected arrival windows for group shuttle scheduling. Marissa, will you collate arrival times and dietary restrictions?

Quote reply inline for clarity:
> "Requested next steps:
> 1) Confirm which two exec suites you want held (701/703 recommended).
> 2) Share your attendee sleep-preferences spreadsheet and indication of which rooms should be ADA / fridge / early-check.
> 3) Confirm whether master bill will be card-on-file or direct invoice for Redwood.
"

We will:
1) Hold 701/703 for CEO + CPO until 7/1 EOD.
2) Send attendee_sleep_preferences_ava_v1.csv by EOD (Ava).
3) Marcus will confirm reconciliation method by Tue 6/30.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Executive Programs
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Pacifica Reservations <reservations@pacifica-hotel.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — block request & adjacency needs (Jul 19-21)

Kelsey / team — quick confirmation from Redwood:

- Please hold exec suites 701/703 for CEO + CPO until 7/1 EOD. We intend to release 703 if not locked by then.
- Master bill: Redwood will accept direct invoice (AP team will process). Marcus will confirm the AP contact and send payment/deposit instructions by EOD Tue (6/30).
- Attached: attendee_sleep_preferences_ava_v1.csv (contains bed type, ADA, early-check requests, dietary fridge flags). Marissa will push a consolidated arrival spreadsheet once she has final flight times.
- Final ask: please include a one-page summary of adjacency guarantees / suite pair hold in the master bill PDF so our legal/ops team can reference it for the contract.

Next internal steps: Marissa to collect arrivals & send to Kelsey by Wed 6/30. Marcus to confirm AP method. Laura will confirm final VIP list.

Thanks — Ava

--
Attachment stubs referenced: attendee_sleep_preferences_ava_v1.csv (CSV, 48 rows); proposed-master-bill-0629.pdf (PDF, 3 pages); initial_block_request.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
